user.title: Select an HDL gateway
user.description: Found {count} HDL gateway(s) on this network (LINK protocol, TCP 8586). Pick the gateway to connect, or choose "Enter gateway IP manually" if nothing was found.

manual.title: Enter gateway IP manually
manual.description: Enter the LAN IP of the HDL main gateway (MGWIP / LINK gateway). The integration reads the function and scene lists from the gateway and lists what can be added.

entities.title: Select functions
entities.description: Gateway {host} ({oid}) exposes {total} functions: {supported} supported, {unsupported} with an unsupported type. The list comes from the gateway function table, not from scanned devices.

secret.title: Local encryption key (optional)
secret.description: The gateway pushes property updates as locally encrypted payloads. Enter the 16-character local key supplied by the installer to decode them in real time. Leave it empty to rely on polling only; control and state still work.

scenes.title: Select scenes
scenes.description: Found {count} scene(s) on the gateway. Selected scenes become scene buttons. You may leave it empty.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway: check the IP, network reachability and that TCP 8586 is open.
error.no_functions: Connected, but no function was returned. Make sure the gateway project has devices configured.

init.title: HDL LINK options
init.description: Gateway {host}: adjust the polling interval, or set the local encryption key to enable live push updates.
